//: Type checking for plain JavaScript. There is no build step and no TypeScript in
the shipped source: this reads the JSDoc annotations and reports what they catch.
DOM and WebWorker cannot both be listed — their globals collide — so DOM is used
and the worker's own globals are annotated where they differ.
NOT a passing gate yet. It currently reports a backlog, most of it from three
patterns rather than three bugs: event handlers assigned by consumers and never
declared on the class, canvas contexts typed as a union that includes
ImageBitmapRenderingContext, and globals the DOM lib does not describe
(navigator.keyboard, AudioWorkletGlobalScope, the vendored trees). Treat the
output as a to-do list, not as CI.
